prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, eye-level shot of a stack of Japanese books and DVDs arranged neatly on a wooden surface, set against a softly blurred, dark green chalkboard background. The stack is composed of colorful DVD cases with Japanese text and vibrant, varied cover designs, interspersed with a few books, including a large, black hardcover volume on the left with white and green Japanese lettering on the spine. The lighting is natural and diffused, casting gentle shadows and highlighting the glossy surfaces of the DVD cases, while the matte texture of the book contrasts subtly. The composition is balanced, with the stack slightly off-center, creating a sense of depth and focus. The overall color palette features muted earth tones from the wood and chalkboard, punctuated by the bright, saturated colors of the DVD covers. The mood is studious and contemplative, evoking a quiet academic or library setting, with a shallow depth of field that draws attention to the details of the books and DVDs while softly blurring the background for a cinematic, documentary-style effect.
